Coverage_Description: Subsidized outpatient dental care at the PolyU Student Dental Clinic (with referral to B&J clinics if campus waiting time exceeds 3 weeks), including oral exam/consultation, scalin; specialist oral surgery cases may be referred and quoted
pricing: HK$: oral exam first visit per academic year free, subsequent visit 30; scaling/polishing 80
customer requirement: Eligible CPCE students in full-time programmes leading to PolyU-HKCC or PolyU-SPEED awards; present student ID card at clinic
price structure: Subsidized fixed fee per treatment item, with some free services; quotation-based fees for specialist-referred oral surgery
additional informations: Effective from 1 Jul 2024; appointments via campus clinic (2330 9414); cancellation with less than 24 hours notice incurs HK$30 penalty (per 15-minute dentist slot / per 30-minute hygienist slot)
